name: Slack
description: Read channels, post messages, and search workspace history from your agent.
notes: The OAuth option uses Slack's official hosted MCP server (requires an internal or Marketplace Slack app, workspace admin approval before users can connect, and OAuth user tokens). The local option runs the maintained open-source slack-mcp-server with app-token auth. Prefer the official hosted server; if using the self-hosted option, prefer OAuth/user-token mode over unapproved stealth/browser-token use.

envFields.label: Bot token
envFields.helperText: Create a [Slack App](https://api.slack.com/apps) with bot token scopes channels:history, channels:read, chat:write, reactions:write, users:read, and users.profile:read. Note: Bot tokens have limited access (invited channels only, no search). For full functionality, use user tokens instead via the OAuth option above.

installHint: For the official hosted server (OAuth option), create or choose a Slack app (internal or Marketplace) and obtain workspace admin approval. For the local server, create a Slack app with bot token scopes channels:history, channels:read, chat:write, reactions:write, users:read, and users.profile:read.
